description: Organizations that help international families with U.S. boarding schools — study-abroad agencies, U.S. guardian services and exchange & student program organizations (J-1 Secondary School Student sponsors and CSIET F-1 programs) — filtered by kind, language, country the family lives in, visa (f1, j1) and U.S. state. Each item shows whether it joined (verified) or appears only from the official lists (`verified.status` unclaimed: not reviewed by USAnaru™), its programs, office city/state, website and the page URL. Ordered by how much information an organization provides, never by payment. Organization-level public facts only — no contact people.

country.description: two-letter country the family comes from, e.g. KR

kind.description: agency, guardian_service or sponsor (exchange & student program organization)

lang.description: Language of the page URLs and of facet/fact names (`name`) returned: en (default), es, ko, zh, vi

language.description: language the organization works in, e.g. ko, zh, vi, es, en

name: list_help_organizations
